answer: The wander assignment is published and mesa records each panel. Shards are assigned from the yarrow graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 7 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1273 impostors cost 295 times the honest price and take 19 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
